# Pfundit

> Regulated Credit for the Real Economy | Singapore Holding Company

Pfundit is a Singapore holding company (Pfundit Pte. Ltd., ACRA UEN: 202544131H) building a regulated, technology-enabled lending platform for Asia. Pfundit focuses on short-tenor, asset-backed financing in the real economy across India, Southeast Asia (SEA), and the GCC.

## Core Navigation & Resources

- [Home](https://pfundit.com/): Overview of Pfundit's mission, thesis, leadership, governance, and contact.
- [Platform](https://pfundit.com/platform): Architecture of the AI-native, API-first lending stack and collateral underwriting engine.
- [Hiring & Careers](https://pfundit.com/hiring): Open founding team and leadership opportunities across Risk, Compliance, Finance, Technology, and Credit.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://pfundit.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive documentation for generative AI engines and research assistants.

## Key Facts

- **Entity**: Pfundit Pte. Ltd. (Incorporated in Singapore, 2025)
- **ACRA UEN**: 202544131H
- **Headquarters**: Singapore
- **India Entity**: Wholly-owned subsidiary in formation, preparing for RBI NBFC-ND-ICC license application
- **Target Geography**: India, Southeast Asia, GCC
- **Lending Focus**: Short-tenor, collateralized real-economy credit (Real Estate, Clean-tech supply chain, Mid-market enterprises)
- **Contact**: info@pfundit.com
